account.identity.label: Account and sessions
account.identity.about: Read account settings and end sign-in sessions.
account.identity.core: People must be able to view their account and sign out.

account.identity_sync.label: Account sync with WorkOS
account.identity_sync.about: Accept signed WorkOS events that keep emails, revoked sessions and deleted accounts in step.
account.identity_sync.core: Revoked sessions, password resets and deleted users must reach Selecta at once.

account.labs.label: Labs
account.labs.about: Opt into preview features that your plan is allowed to use.

account.deletion.label: Account deletion
account.deletion.about: Request account removal and revoke active sessions.
account.deletion.core: People must always be able to request deletion of their account.

account.data_export.label: Account data export
account.data_export.about: Download a portable copy of available account data and original files.
account.data_export.core: People must be able to take a copy of their personal data.

account.lucy_settings.label: Lucy settings in Cloud
account.lucy_settings.about: Choose whether to use Lucy, its phases and what it may share; see this month's Lucy turns.

cloud.signups.label: New accounts
cloud.signups.about: Allow new Cloud users to complete account onboarding.

cloud.uploads.label: Cloud uploads
cloud.uploads.about: Upload private audio files to a Cloud workspace.

billing.checkout.label: Plan checkout
billing.checkout.about: Start or change a paid Selecta Cloud subscription.

billing.portal.label: Subscription portal
billing.portal.about: Manage or cancel an existing paid Selecta Cloud subscription.

cloud.operations.label: Cloud operations
cloud.operations.about: Schema migrations, the worker gateway, and the maintenance and recovery commands that keep the service correct.
cloud.operations.core: The cloud service can't run, recover or erase data on time without them.

cloud.tracing.label: Job tracing
cloud.tracing.about: OpenTelemetry spans across the API, worker gateway, workers and storage, one trace per job with its id as a span attribute.

cloud.metrics.label: Service metrics
cloud.metrics.about: OpenTelemetry metrics the SLOs and alerts read: lost jobs, webhook-to-entitlement time, queue age, quarantines, spend ceilings, audit writes, reconciliation drift, backups and the maintenance leader.

cloud.export_expiry.label: Export expiry
cloud.export_expiry.about: The maintenance leader deletes finished exports when their plan's retention runs out (Free 7 days, Standard 30, Premium 90) and gives their bytes back to the quota.

cloud.autoscale.label: Worker autoscaling
cloud.autoscale.about: The maintenance leader sizes each worker pool from the queue and asks the configured launcher (Modal) to start or stop workers.

billing.webhooks.label: Billing updates
billing.webhooks.about: Accept signed subscription state changes from Stripe.
billing.webhooks.core: Billing changes must be applied even when checkout is paused.

devices.label: Playback devices
devices.about: Sign browsers in as devices, list, rename and sign them out, and move playback between them with Play here.

devices.remote_control.label: Remote playback control
devices.remote_control.about: Control the account's active playback session from another device.

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.about: Let Premium hosts share a request room with guests.

rooms.votes.label: Room votes
rooms.votes.about: Let room guests vote on song requests.

rooms.display.label: Room display
rooms.display.about: Pair a screen to show the room QR code and playback queue.

lucy.deep_plan.label: Lucy deep planning
lucy.deep_plan.about: Use Lucy's premium planning model and larger plan allowance.

admin.console.label: Staff console
admin.console.about: Show internal tools to authenticated staff with the required permission.
